description: Turns any signal into a gate, and into triggers at the start and end of that gate

inputs.text: The signal being converted; the gate goes high over 2V and returns low below 0.1V

outputs.text: 10V while the input is over 2V, dropping to 0V once the input falls below 0.1V
0V while the input is over 2V, rising to 10V once the input falls below 0.1V
A trigger at 10V the moment the gate goes high
A trigger at 10V the moment the gate goes low
A trigger at 10V on both edges of the gate, when it goes high and again when it goes low

notes: this module is monophonic: only the first channel of a polyphonic cable is read, and every output carries a single channel

inputs.0: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
